recipe.name: Aamrakhand Old Fashioned
recipe.description: A luscious, spiced twist on the classic featuring smooth blended Scotch infused with sweet, fruity mango shrikhand and fragrant warming spices.
steps: Add the aamrakhand and ground cardamom into a mixing glass.
Pour in the Dewar's White Label and stir vigorously to dissolve and integrate the aamrakhand with the whisky.
Add ice to the mixing glass and stir until properly chilled and diluted.
Fine strain the mixture into a rocks glass over a large ice cube.
Garnish with freshly grated nutmeg over the top.
recipe.serving: Serve immediately with a cocktail stirrer
